newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares soar after SKB's spectacular run.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares soar after SKB's spectacular run.

text.p: Slovenian shares jumped 3.53 percent on Friday after spectacular gains in the shares of bank SKB. Traders said the market would likely come under correction after today's steep rise.

"SKB was obviously pushed up by news that there's been strong demand for its global depository receipts abroad -- the share price could grow over 90,000 tolars," Karmen Korbun, a trader at bank Creditanstalt said.
* The 10-share SBI index rose 53.65 points to 1,573.6.
* Bank SKB was the most active and the biggest gainer, jumping 25.62 percent to 73,800 tolars on volume of 13,687 shares.
* Overall nine shares rose, seven fell and nine were untraded.
